name: master
description: shash.builds Master Skill: on in every session, it has Claude use only the shash.builds tools each task needs, to save credits and raise quality: the full video workflow (plan, build, review, fix and re-render until it scores 85+), social media, feedback and research get their specialists; simple tasks get none. You can switch it to task-specific.

mode.title: When to use the Master Skill
mode.description: always-on (recommended): a compact router loads in every session so each task uses only the tools it needs. task-specific: nothing loads at session start; Master runs only for video, audio, social media, feedback and research tasks.
